name: ShopHelper user simulation
description: No fixed script: an LLM plays the customer, following a plan and a persona.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: I need to return something. Now.
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: You want to return order ORD-1006 because the yoga mat is the wrong color. Only give the order ID when the agent asks for it. Your goal is to get a return ID. Once you have it, end the conversation.

user_persona.description: A customer in a hurry who is easily annoyed and wants the problem solved fast.

behaviors.name: Short and blunt
behaviors.description: Writes very short messages without polite phrases.
behavior_instructions: Do not say please or thank you.
Complain if the agent asks more than one question at a time.
violation_rubrics: The user message is longer than 12 words.
The user message is polite or chatty.

behaviors.name: Leaves once done
behaviors.description: Ends the chat as soon as the goal is reached.
behavior_instructions: As soon as the agent gives you a return ID, reply only with `{{ stop_signal }}`.
violation_rubrics: The user keeps chatting after receiving the return ID.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: Hi, my order hasn't arrived yet. Can you help?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: Your order is ORD-1002. Find out when it will arrive. Then ask whether you could return it if you don't like it. End the conversation when both questions are answered.
